text.zh: 专业术语首次出现时标注中英对照；后续正文使用英文缩写。术语密集时在文末附术语对照表；引用外文资料时保留原文术语并附中文释义。
text.en: On the first occurrence of a technical term, give both the Chinese and English forms; afterwards use the English abbreviation. When terms are dense, add a glossary at the end. When citing foreign-language sources, keep the original term and add a Chinese explanation.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 正文中首次出现专业术语时；术语密集时；引用外文资料时
trigger.en: On the first occurrence of a technical term; when terms are dense; when citing foreign-language sources

purpose.zh: 让读者对应上中英术语，并保留外文资料的原意
purpose.en: Let readers match the Chinese and English terms and keep the original meaning of foreign sources

exclude.zh: 同一术语的后续出现（改用英文缩写）；不含专业术语的内容
exclude.en: Later occurrences of the same term (use the English abbreviation); content without technical terms
